items.source:
Entrypoint for creating $lookup using a fluent builder API. 
Aggregation.lookup().from("restaurants").localField("restaurant_name").foreignField("name")
                .let(newVariable("orders_drink").forField("drink"))
                .pipeline(match(ctx -> new Document("$expr", new Document("$in", List.of("$$orders_drink", "$beverages")))))
                .as("matches")
items.translation:
创建使用流式构建器 API 的 $lookup 操作的入口点。 
Aggregation.lookup().from("restaurants").localField("restaurant_name").foreignField("name")
                .let(newVariable("orders_drink").forField("drink"))
                .pipeline(match(ctx -> new Document("$expr", new Document("$in", List.of("$$orders_drink", "$beverages")))))
                .as("matches")

                .otherwise(RedactOperation.DESCEND));

items.source: An Aggregation is a representation of a list of aggregation steps to be performed by the MongoDB Aggregation Framework.
items.translation: `Aggregation` 是表示由 MongoDB 聚合框架执行的一系列聚合步骤的列表。
